mechanism_claim: Among already-B0-eligible names, a 'dry pullback' (declining volume into the IBD pivot leg) is a valid continuation signal only when the breakout print itself is volume-confirmed (ibd_entry_volume_ratio above an arm-specific threshold); without that cross-confirmation, the apparent base-pullback looks like distribution rather than accumulation, and the entry is a false-positive ruin even though other IBD/RS gates passed.
evidence_for: False-positive ruins in pullback-history cases (entity_8f0df3d38e: pullback -16.2% / 7wk / vol_ratio_5_20=1.24; entity_ccc90a671f: -14.4% / 7wk / 1.45; entity_55c2da490e: -12.3% / 7wk / 1.27) sit at sub-confirmation entry-volume levels (ibd_entry_volume_ratio cluster 1.2-1.45), whereas the high-weight selected winners with comparable pullbacks (entity_2c58cebc59: -25.1% / 6wk / 1.62; entity_3adc078f01: -42.3% / 9wk / 1.14-1.40 band) carry entry-volume ratios distinctly above the ruin cluster — confirming dry-pullback alone is insufficient.

entity_40ea0cfb3b is the cleanest counter-case: no pullback-leg data, ibd_entry_volume_ratio=0.91, mom_20=0.024, up_day_ratio=0.5, and it is a ruin — showing that when the pullback-volume context is missing the entry-volume ratio itself must carry the gate.
evidence_against: entity_de1c657364 is a large_winner that the piecewise gate would still down-grade (pullback 8wk/-7.3%, vol_ratio_5_20=1.15, entry VR consistent with the sub-confirmation band) — so the rule accepts some left-tail false_negatives in exchange for clearing the ruins.

entity_6618d3e80c shows a 'false_positive_ruin|selected_winner' mixed label with pullback=null and high entry VR (1.45) — entry-volume confirmation alone is non-sufficient when mom_20 also elevated (0.251), implying the threshold needs to be arm-conditioned on pullback-v-dry state rather than a single global VR cut.
falsifiable_predictions: Restrict B0 to candidates satisfying (pullback_v_is_dry AND ibd_entry_volume_ratio >= ~1.5) OR (NOT pullback_v_is_dry AND ibd_entry_volume_ratio >= ~1.6 AND ma10_slope_5 > 0); demote the rest within B0 (do NOT add a new eligibility class). Expect ruin-rate on the demoted bucket > 2x the kept bucket on a holdout, while the kept bucket's large_win ratio improves vs unrestricted B0.

Within kept-B0, expect mean ibd_entry_volume_ratio of selected_winners to exceed that of false_positive_ruins by >=0.15 on a frozen-equal-period holdout; failure to detect this gap falsifies the cross-confirmation mechanism.
policy_implications: Encode as a post-B0 ranking/confirmation stage: compute pullback_v_is_dry (pullback-leg median volume < uptrend-leg median volume by a defined ratio) and ibd_entry_volume_ratio, then apply the piecewise cut to demote (not eliminate) candidates — this preserves the B0 universe size and only reorders conviction.

Use this filter as a sanity check before sizing up; candidates that pass the dry-pullback+confirmed-volume arm can carry full B0 weight, while the wet-pullback-or-unconfirmed arm should size at the B1/watchlist level, separating predictive edge from portfolio-construction leverage.
